prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style from the reference: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with small label "Memory trick".
Heading verbatim: "en översvämning". English meaning verbatim: "flood".
Scene: A flooded riverside path after heavy rain, water beyond the normal riverbank and people safely on higher ground.
Memory caption verbatim: "översvämning = flood.".
Bottom Swedish example verbatim: "Kraftigt regn orsakade en översvämning.". Teach only this sense.
